evidence.1000: In top, the trim is dark charcoal on all four sides and matches the charred field. Apart from a hairline lighter outer bevel on the left edge (about x 153, y 50–950), it shows no light protected rim. In front-three-quarter, the only warm value on the trim is the lit lower-left thickness face (about x 60–480, y 430–710), which is lighting on the slab edge. Rear-three-quarter has fully dark trim. In front, the end caps are dark squares (about x 52–76 and x 924–948). Left and right are thin dark strips.
evidence.256: Top shows no light outline. Front-three-quarter keeps only a faint lit lower-left edge.
evidence.128: Front-three-quarter, rear-three-quarter and top all read as a dark plate with a warm left zone.

nonBlockingObservations: In 1000-top, the panel interior is still a smooth lateral airbrush gradient with faint vertical banding steps (about x 250–290, x 470 and x 650). This is accepted within the existing whole-field breakup scope.
